item.title: State root, quorum-signed momentums and a Pillar finality gadget
item.body:
Every momentum header carries a state root and the next producer set, and is signed by
more than two thirds of producing weight, so it is final in seconds instead of after 90
momentums and a light client can verify a balance against a header (roadmap M6).

- A commitment over embedded storage and account heads
- Ed25519 attestations aggregated off-chain and carried in the next momentum
- Two conflicting attestations by one Pillar as evidence anyone can post
